question: The average age of 34 students of a class is 29 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 30 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new member = Old Average + (Total new members × Increase in Average)

Old Average = 29 years

Total new members = 34 + 1 = 35

Increase in Average = 30 − 29 = 1 year

Teacher's Age = 29 + (35 × 1) = 64 years

**∴ The correct answer is 64 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 34 students = 29 years

Average age after including the teacher = 30 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Sum of 34 Students = 34 × 29 = 986
 
 Sum of 35 Persons (with Teacher) = 35 × 30 = 1050
 

 Increase = Teacher's Age = 64

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 34 students = 34 × 29

⇒ Total age of 34 students = 986 years

⇒ Total number of persons = 34 students + 1 teacher = 35

⇒ Total age of 35 persons = 35 × 30

⇒ Total age of 35 persons = 1050 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 35 persons − Total age of 34 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 1050 − 986 = 64 years

**∴ The correct answer is 64 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion of a New Member

If adding a person increases the average of n members by x, the new member's value is: Old Average + (n + 1) × x.

Exclusion of a Member

If a person leaves and the average of the remaining n−1 members drops by y, the departing person's value is: Old Average + (n − 1) × y.

Replacement Method

If a new person replaces an old one and the average increases by z, the new person's value = Replaced person's value + n × z.
